title: Example 143: ASCII fast path off by one at U+0080 refuted by the own checker with path merging
description: Runs build.py on example 143 (B9, approach.engine native): the regression proof of Mica's ModifiedUtf8#encodeInto with an ASCII fast path whose test admits U+0080, against the previous version, by the tool's own checker with paths merged at join points. Expected: violation on encodeInto(chars=['\u0080'], out=[32]) after shrinking (the previous version throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException writing the second byte, the new one returns 1 having written 0x80), in about 5 s and under 100 MB.
